Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 3x2 control-button atlas for the AURUM FORGE premium mobile slot game
Primary request: create exactly six isolated, clearly readable, physical casino-machine controls in a strict 3 columns by 2 rows atlas, one centered control per equal square cell. Row 1: HOME as a compact ivory-enamel art-deco house emblem in a round emerald-gold bezel; RULES as an open ivory rulebook with two simple blank pages in a round emerald-gold bezel; SOUND as a clear gold speaker cone with two emerald sound waves in a round bezel. Row 2: ADD COINS as one blank gold coin with a bold raised plus sign in a small emerald-gold bezel; AUTO as two broad circular gold arrows around one emerald gemstone in a round bezel; SPIN as one large substantial round emerald-glass push button with a molten-gold flame emblem in its center and a thick champagne-gold mechanical rim.
Style/medium: high-end commercial 3D casino cabinet control hardware, polished stylized realism, coherent with champagne-gold and emerald foundry machinery, clean silhouettes at mobile size
Composition/framing: exact orthographic front view, exact regular 3x2 atlas, identical lighting and scale logic, every object fully contained with generous uniform padding, no overlap or dividers
Lighting/mood: warm controlled top-left studio light, crisp gold edges, emerald glass depth, no excessive bloom
Text: none except the universally understood raised plus sign on ADD
Constraints: perfectly flat uniform chroma-key magenta #FF00FF background edge to edge; no magenta on controls; exactly six objects; no words, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, crown, wheel, detached particles, cast-shadow rectangle, black halo or sticker-like outline
Avoid: generic web icons, flat vector buttons, toy plastic, S07 red-and-blue royal controls, illegible symbols, inconsistent perspective, cropped controls
